sources.description: English vanilla localization of Victoria 3 (commands observed in use; meanings inferred from name and usage)

notes.text: Bracketed [...] data functions are replaced at runtime. Keep them exactly, including saved-scope calls such as [SCOPE.sCharacter('name').Function] and any |modifiers.
Formatting uses #tag text#! (for example #b, #italic, #r, #blue); each nested tag needs its own #!. Icons are @key!; $key$ inserts another localization key.
[concept_name] and [Concept('concept_name','text')] are concept links with a tooltip. Dropping one loses the tooltip even if the plain word is translated.

zh-CN.text: 中文本地化里代词命令输出他/她；中文没有主格宾格之分，任何代词命令都可作主语或宾语。
因中文习惯省略重复的代词命令是合理的，前提是指代仍然清楚；不要把代词命令写死成“他”或“她”。没有必要时，应尽量保持与原文相同的命令引用。

suffixes.NoFormatting: same value as plain text without formatting or tooltip
suffixes.NoFlag: same value without the country flag

scopes.SCOPE: saved-scope accessor, used as SCOPE.sCountry('name'), SCOPE.sCharacter('name') and similar

GetName.meaning: name as a tooltipped string; countries also show a flag

GetNameNoFlag.meaning: country name as a tooltipped string without flag

GetAdjective.meaning: country adjective as a tooltipped string

GetPrimaryRoleTitle.meaning: character's primary role title as a tooltipped string

GetGoods.meaning: the named goods as an object for further functions

ScriptValue.meaning: calculated value of the named script value

Concept.meaning: concept link with alternate display text: Concept('concept_key','text'); in Remis keep the whole Victoria 3 Concept token exactly as in the source, including the label

GetSheHe.meaning: pronoun she or he by gender

GetHerHis.meaning: pronoun her or his by gender

GetHerselfHimself.meaning: reflexive pronoun herself or himself by gender

sCountry.meaning: saved-scope accessor for a country saved with save_scope_as

sCharacter.meaning: saved-scope accessor for a character saved with save_scope_as

GetLocalVariable.meaning: script variable accessor; usually followed by .GetValue

GetValue.meaning: numeric value of the preceding object

GetHerHim.meaning: pronoun her or him by gender

GetWomanMan.meaning: the word woman or man by gender

GetCityHubName.meaning: name of the state's city hub

GetFarmHubName.meaning: name of the state's farm hub

GetNameWithCountryVariant.meaning: name of an interest group or similar object in its country-specific variant

GetDescFor.meaning: description text of the object for the given scope

GetDefine.meaning: numeric value of a game define; its arguments are conditions and localization keys or markup, not translatable text

SelectLocalization.meaning: chooses one of the given localization keys or icons by a condition; its arguments are conditions and localization keys or markup, not translatable text

AddLocalizationIf.meaning: inserts the given localization key when the condition is true; its arguments are conditions and localization keys or markup, not translatable text

AddTextIf.meaning: inserts the given text when the condition is true; its arguments are conditions and localization keys or markup, not translatable text

ConcatIfNeitherEmpty.meaning: joins two values with a separator when neither is empty; its arguments are conditions and localization keys or markup, not translatable text

patterns.meaning: arithmetic helper that prints a number; keep the expression unchanged
